build_mmdet_backbone: build an MMDetBackbone with a DetectoRS_ResNet backbone and FPN neck for feature extraction
build_mmdet_detector: build an MMDetDetector with a Mask R-CNN configuration including RPN head and ROI head
test_mmdet_backbone: test the MMDetBackbone class by instantiating it with a DetectoRS_ResNet config and FPN neck
test_mmdet_detector: test the MMDetDetector class by instantiating it with a full Mask R-CNN detector config
review_mmdet_wrapper: review the MMDetBackbone and MMDetDetector wrapper classes that bridge MMDetection models into Detectron2
